import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000009;
    static final int[] dx = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    
    static int N, T;
    static char[][] gridA = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] dist = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];
    
    static class Point {
        int x, y;
        Point(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }
    
    static void bfs(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(visited[i], false);
        Queue<Point> q = new LinkedList<>();
        visited[sx][sy] = true;
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.offer(new Point(sx, sy));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Point cur = q.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nx = cur.x + dx[i], ny = cur.y + dy[i];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N && !visited[nx][ny] && Character.isDigit(gridA[nx][ny])) {
                    visited[nx][ny] = true;
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[cur.x][cur.y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new Point(nx, ny));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static boolean[][][][][] dp = new boolean[72][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][][][] reachable = new boolean[12][12][12][12];
    
    static int[][] capacity = new int[290][290];
    static int[] parent = new int[290];
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[290];
    
    static boolean bfsFlow() {
        Arrays.fill(vis, false);
        Arrays.fill(parent, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        vis[0] = true;
        q.offer(0);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            if (u == 2 * N * N + 1) return true;
            for (int v = 0; v <= 2 * N * N + 1; ++v) {
                if (capacity[u][v] > 0 && !vis[v]) {
                    vis[v] = true;
                    parent[v] = u;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) 
            gridA[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) 
            gridB[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        int sx = sc.nextInt();
        int sy = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        bfs(sx, sy);
        for (int t = 0; t < 72; ++t)
            for (int i = 0; i < 12; ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < 12; ++j)
                    for (int k = 0; k < 12; ++k)
                        for (int l = 0; l < 12; ++l)
                            dp[t][i][j][k][l] = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(gridA[i][j])) {
                    dp[0][i][j][i][j] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {
            for (int px = 0; px < N; ++px) {
                for (int py = 0; py < N; ++py) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < N; ++x) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < N; ++y) {
                            if (!dp[t][px][py][x][y]) continue;
                            if (dist[x][y] <= t) continue;
                            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                                if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N && Character.isDigit(gridA[nx][ny]) && dist[nx][ny] >= t + 1) {
                                    dp[t + 1][px][py][nx][ny] = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; ++j)
                for (int k = 0; k < 12; ++k)
                    for (int l = 0; l < 12; ++l)
                        reachable[i][j][k][l] = false;
        for (int t = 0; t <= T; ++t) {
            for (int px = 0; px < N; ++px) {
                for (int py = 0; py < N; ++py) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < N; ++x) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < N; ++y) {
                            if (dp[t][px][py][x][y]) {
                                reachable[px][py][x][y] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 290; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(capacity[i], 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(gridA[i][j])) {
                    capacity[0][i * N + j + 1] = gridA[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(gridB[i][j])) {
                    capacity[N * N + i * N + j + 1][2 * N * N + 1] = gridB[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (!Character.isDigit(gridA[i][j])) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < N; ++l) {
                        if (!Character.isDigit(gridA[k][l])) continue;
                        if (!reachable[i][j][k][l]) continue;
                        capacity[i * N + j + 1][N * N + k * N + l + 1] = INF;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        while (bfsFlow()) {
            int flow = INF;
            for (int u = 2 * N * N + 1; u != 0; u = parent[u]) {
                flow = Math.min(flow, capacity[parent[u]][u]);
            }
            for (int u = 2 * N * N + 1; u != 0; u = parent[u]) {
                capacity[parent[u]][u] -= flow;
                capacity[u][parent[u]] += flow;
            }
        }
        int result = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * N * N + 1; ++i) {
            result += capacity[i][0];
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
}
